_doc: T-141 account routing: sleeve/strategy -> account mapping + the two research rules.
Validated by core/account_router.py::validate_routing (config+check only; no live enforcement yet).
RULE A: st_heavy sleeves may sit in taxable only with after-tax evidence (after_tax_sharpe_taxable ci_low > 0).
RULE B: cross_account_wash_sale = 'disjoint_universes' (ticker in exactly one account's universe) or 'blackout_31d' (31-day cross-account blackout after a taxable realized loss; Rev. Rul. 2008-5).
Tax RATES live in backtest_settings.json::tax_drag_model (single source), not here.
These are engineering constraints encoding published IRS guidance - not tax advice.
